comparison.objective: Press two 2×2 studded blocks together across four studs and verify the joint by lifting; candidate breaks sacrificial tangs from retained inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-stud alignment, press-fit engagement, and load-bearing lift versus coaxial mandrel placement, impact fracture, careful withdrawal, and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: All four studs joined and lower block retained during a lift before release; candidate requires four tangs separated and contained while the inserts remain fixed and undamaged.
comparison.reason: Assembly and joint-retention testing are opposite in outcome and mechanically different from controlled sacrificial-feature fracture.
